Chapter 307 What If I Break Through

I saw a terrifying aura suddenly came from the bronze palace in front of me.

The scorching waves continued to overflow from the palace gate.

The next moment, there was a bang.

The huge bronze door suddenly opened.

And just then, Chen Mingyu suddenly spoke, "Go!"

In just a moment, the five figures rushed in directly.

"Sister Xue, they're in!"

In the distance, Qin Feng, who was hiding here, suddenly spoke.

However, Lu Xue frowned.

"What's that Chen Mingyu's strength?"

Hearing this, Xiao Luo said in a deep voice: "The 19th place in the Monster List is probably almost at the third level of the Immortal Emperor Realm."

"The third level of the Immortal Emperor Realm?"

Lu Xue frowned a little deeper.

"guess."

"That's not here yet."

Through what Xiao Luo brought back, he learned that Chen Mingyu and the other two obviously did not want to be open to the Bronze Palace.

If you enter blindly, if you encounter each other, you may have a fierce battle.

Lu Xue looked at Ao Qing who was dozing on her shoulders.

After working hard to eat, sleep and eat, Ao Qing has now reached the sixth level of the Immortal Saint Realm.

It is only one step away from the late stage of the Immortal Saint Realm.

In Ao Qing's words, there is no pressure when facing the ordinary early stage of the Immortal Emperor Realm. Even if you are of level, you will have the power to fight.

However, Lu Xue is a little unsure.

Who knows how good Chen Mingyu's level is in Ao Qing's words?

Alas, if she reaches the Immortal Saint Realm, or Ao Qing reaches the late stage of the Immortal Saint Realm, she won’t have to hesitate so much.

The main reason is that there are only four of them in total. Not only is the other party one more person than them, but there is also a gun god Chen Mingyu.

A little difficult to deal with.

"Xiao Luo, can you call some helpers?"

Lu Xue looked at Xiao Luo and asked.

Hearing this, Xiao Luo was slightly stunned, "Help? Sister Xue, stop joking, what helper can I call me?"

"I'm afraid I'm the only one in this ancient battlefield in the entire Xiao clan."

Lu Xue had no choice but to look at Qin Feng again.

Qin Feng also wanted to pretend at this moment, but the only thing he deserves to mention is that he is a disciple of Teacher Wang Hao.

Unless, he calls his fellow disciples over.

But he doesn't have that condition either.

Qin Feng spread his hands and said that he was powerless.

Seeing this, Lu Xue sighed again.

At this moment, she missed the days when she once called the wind and rain.

He is surrounded by his unfathomable bodyguards at any time.

There is a master, Ouyang Sister, An Xing, and Awei. If it were once, as soon as I shouted, I would appear in front of me.

Even my daddy is the same.

But now, I can't even call someone.

Seeing Lu Xue lowering her head and looking down, Xiao Luo and the others were helpless.

Since Lu Xue was slashed by the giant's sword last time, Lu Xue has become depraved.

"Sister Xue, you will lead us to save the savior of the immortal world in the future. Do you have to shrink when facing Chen Mingyu?"

Xiao Luo stepped forward and said firmly.

On the side, Qin Feng was also infected by these words and nodded, "Xiao Luo said it well, Sister Xue, you can't fall into depravity anymore."

The two of them kept inspiring Lu Xue with powerful words.

Even Ao Qing opened his sleepy eyes and looked at the two of them.

At this time, Lu Xue grabbed Ao Qing and put it behind her head, and lay down flat.

"I'm tired, let's destroy it."

"Whoever wants to save this fairy world will save you."

Lu Xue waved her hand and slapped it directly on the spot.

Xiao Luoqinfeng:!

Ao Qing:?

And at this moment, a buzzing sound suddenly came from the bronze palace.

In an instant, the whole world began to tremble, and the storm and clouds changed drastically.

Looking at the strangeness coming from the sky, Xiao Luo and the others quickly said excitedly: "There are treasures, there are treasures!"

"Sister Xue, get up quickly, there is a treasure!"

The two pointed to the direction of the bronze palace, looking excited.

But Lu Xue turned a deaf ear to her.

I have never seen any storms.

I've made it all the time, what other treasures do I need?

However, Ao Qing's eyes shone at this moment, "My master, you can't be so depraved anymore. If the master knew, he would definitely be angry."

Lu Xue didn't say anything.

The next moment, Ao Qing's body began to expand, and then a golden light flashed.

Ao Qing directly carried Lu Xue and flew towards the direction of the bronze palace.

"You two are here to keep up!"

Ao Qing's voice spread farther and farther.

Seeing this, Xiao Luo and the others quickly reacted.

At the same time, Lu Xue lay on Ao Qing's back and shouted loudly: "You let me go, I don't want it, I want to put it on!"

But this time, it was Ao Qing's turn to turn a deaf ear.

In his eyes, there was only the holy light coming from the bronze palace.

As a dragon clan, he is extremely sensitive to treasures.

He could feel that there was really a treasure inside.

In the blink of an eye, Ao Qing had already brought Lu Xue to the palace gate.

It was pitch black inside and there was no way to see the situation inside.

At this time, Xiao Luo and the others followed.

Seeing the two, Ao Qing said directly: "You two go in and explore the way."

Hearing this, Xiao Luo and the others were immediately furious.

"Why don't you go?!"

Ao Qing snorted and said, "Of course I want to protect the little master. Who else can you go? Let the little master give in?"

As he said that, Ao Qing patted Lu Xue on her back, her face turned ashen, and she wanted to cry without tears.

"Don't go too far, who has the final say here?"

However, no one paid attention to Lu Xue at this time.

Xiao Luo and the others had no choice but to enter the Bronze Palace.

As soon as I entered, a hazy aura spread throughout my body, and the next moment, it disappeared again.

laugh!

Just then, a sword light hit.

Qin Feng, maintaining his perception of the sword, quickly yelled, "Be careful!"

A flash of light.

The two finally entered the bronze palace.

Looking into his eyes, a bottomless corridor appeared in front of the two of them.

But at this moment, the two of them were in a cold sweat.

If Qin Feng hadn't reacted in time just now, they might have been different from each other.

“That’s human.”

Qin Feng said with a serious expression.

Xiao Luo punched the wall, and a buzzing sound came from the whole way, "It's them!"

Chen Mingyu and the other five.

Xiao Luo looked angry, but he didn't expect that these people looked so despicable.

As soon as I came in, I set up a trap in a blink of an eye.

Qin Feng's eyes were also filled with anger at this moment.

"Don't worry about them for now, I'll call Sister Xue and the others in."

A moment later, Ao Qing entered the Bronze Palace with Lu Xue, who looked reluctant.

"Hmm? Why are you two not very good-looking? Are you really in danger?"

Ao Qing looked at the two of them and said in confusion.

Immediately, Xiao Luo told the story of Chen Mingyu and others setting up a killer.

Hearing this, Ao Qing snorted coldly, "It's so shameless."

Lu Xue also looked cold.

Obviously, Lu Xue was angry.

"Let's go and find them."

Lu Xue changed her decadence and spoke gloomy.

Upon hearing this, Xiao Luo hesitated and said, "Sister Xue, can't we beat them?"

Lu Xue's expression remained unchanged.

"What if I break through?"
